user.title: Perch for Home Assistant
user.description: Perch lets your Apple TV show your cameras, doorbell and lights without holding a Home Assistant token. After this, pair each TV from this integration's page with "Pair a TV".

abort.already_configured: Perch is already set up. Pair another TV from the integration's page.

user.title: Pair a TV
user.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown on {tv_name}. Pairing works only on your home network.

confirm.title: Check the words
confirm.description:
{tv_name} should now show these four words:

**{words}**

Pick "The words match" only if the TV shows exactly the same words.

reconfigure.title: Rooms for {tv_name}
reconfigure.description: Choose the room this TV is in, and any other rooms it may control. Its own room is always included.

data.let_in_allowed: This TV may let people in

data_description.let_in_allowed: Off by default. The let-in PIN and a recent ring are still needed.

error.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check the TV and try again.

abort.not_loaded: Perch is not running. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.no_pending: No TV is waiting to pair. Open Perch on the TV, choose to pair with Home Assistant, then try again.
abort.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes, so this pairing was stopped. Start again on the TV.
abort.aborted: Two TVs answered the same code, so this pairing was stopped. Start again on the TV you want to pair.
abort.mismatch: Pairing cancelled because the words did not match. Start again on the TV.

init.title: What Perch can show
init.description: Pick what your TVs may use. Perch can only use what you choose here. Next you can say which camera goes with the doorbell and which scenes are Movie night and Paused. Rooms and lights are set per TV: open a TV and choose Reconfigure.

data_description.doorbell: A binary sensor or event that fires when someone rings.
data_description.scenes: Choose the scenes your TVs may run.

data.allow_cloud: Allow Perch through Home Assistant Cloud

data_description.pairing_attempts: Wrong codes allowed before pairing stops. From 3 to 10.
data_description.allow_cloud: Lets a TV reach Perch through Home Assistant Cloud when away from home. Pairing a TV always needs your home network, even with this switched on.

phone.name: Tell my phone
phone.description: Perch can tell your phone when a request is ready to watch. Let-in lockout notices go to the same phones.

data.notify_request_ready: Tell my phone when a request is ready

data_description.notify_services: Pick one or more notify services. The TV never chooses where a message goes.
data_description.notify_request_ready: Off until you switch it on. Each title is told once.
data_description.notify_include_title: Off by default, because the name shows on a locked phone. Without it the message is "Your request is ready to watch".

let_in.name: Let someone in
let_in.description: When the doorbell rings, an allowed TV can run a script you choose, for example to unlock the door and lock it again. Perch never uses a lock itself. It works only within 2 minutes of a ring, only with the let-in PIN, and only on TVs you allow (open a TV and choose Reconfigure). Three wrong PINs lock it for 15 minutes, then 1 hour, then switch it off until you switch it on here again.

data_description.let_in_enabled: Off by default. Switching it on again after a lockout clears the lockout.
data_description.let_in_script: Perch runs this script and nothing else.
data_description.let_in_pin: 6 to 12 digits. Use a PIN of its own, not one you use anywhere else. Leave empty to keep the current PIN. Home Assistant keeps only a scrambled copy.

details.title: Doorbell and scenes
details.description: Only what you picked on the last page is offered here. All of these are optional.

data_description.doorbell_camera: The camera Perch shows when the doorbell rings.

error.same_scene: Movie night and Paused need different scenes.
error.notify_unknown: One of the phones you picked is no longer in Home Assistant.
error.notify_needs_service: Pick at least one phone to tell.
error.let_in_pin_mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
error.let_in_pin_format: The let-in PIN must be 6 to 12 digits.
error.let_in_needs_script: Pick the script to run before switching let-in on.
error.let_in_needs_pin: Set a let-in PIN before switching let-in on.
error.let_in_needs_doorbell: Pick a doorbell trigger before switching let-in on. Let-in only works after a ring.
